snippet.title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii | Combat Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Are ye ready to kick some arrrss? Take a deep dive into the combat found Like a Dragon: PIrate Yakuza in Hawaii, setting sail on Feb 21st. 

Pre-order add Ichiban Kasuga and Nancy to your crew plus the ability to have Majima change into two of Ichiban Kasuga's iconic outfits.
